w: Before attending the main evening assembly, Swamishri addressed 400 spiritually inclined visitors and aspirants.
In his evening's discourse Swamishri highlighted the importance of righteous living and business ethics.
Swamishri was honored by the Mayor of Rajkot, Shri Ashokbhai Dangar, with the title of 'Sant Shiromani' and the 'The Best Citizen Award'. Lord Harikrishna Maharaj was honored by a devotee.
A week prior to the Joli utsav, a symbolic Joli utsav was held in the presence of Swamishri. Swamishri pulled the kite-string to the rejoicement of devotees.
The first day of the 3-day Swaminarayan Mahamantra Bicentenary Celebrations. (News report)

st.t: Swaminarayan Mahamantra Bicentenary Celebration - Diksha Ceremony
w: At 8.00 am, the festival ground - Swaminarayan Nagar, was ceremoniously inaugurated by senior sadhus and dignitaries. Pramukh Swami Maharaj ritually performed pujan and pradakshina of the mantra books placed on the giant Mantra Vedika and offered respects to the mahamantra and devotion of thousands of devotees. During the next 3-days, thousands of devotees offered their respects and reverence by performing pradakshina of the vedika.

Thereafter, four traditional huts for singing the Swaminarayan dhun (mantra-dhun), saying the mantra (mantra-jap) with a rosary, writing the mantra and chanting the mantra while offering grains in a yagna-pit (mantra-homa), were declared open by Swamishri. During the 3-days these traditional huts resonated with the singing and writing of the Swaminarayan mantra by children and devotees.

After Swamishri's morning puja, a diksha-ceremony of 60 youths took place at the holy hands of Swamishri. This added another chapter in Swamishri's efforts to elevate society through his selfless order of sadhus.

During this event, MP for Bhavnagar Shri Rajendrasinh Rana praised Swamishri's efforts in elevating society morally and spiritually. Finally, Swamishri blessed the assembly, "Gadhpur is the holiest of holy places sanctified by Bhagwan Swaminarayan. He had inspired morality and spirituality by spreading the Swaminarayan mahamantra from house to house through His paramhansas. Pujya Shastriji Maharaj and Pujya Yogiji Maharaj spread the mahamantra in India and abroad. By chanting this mahamantra with faith and resolution, one will experience peace of mind.

"Our scriptures say that if we protect dharma, then dharma will protect us. Today, the roots of terrorism lie in the decline of dharma in our world. These newly initiated sadhus will contribute in consolidating dharma in society…"
'Swaminarayan Nagar' (Festival site) The celebration was held in 'Swaminarayan Nagar' - the 125-acre festival venue. The main features of the festival grounds were:

The giant 20´ x 20´ yagna vedika filled with 4,50,000 Swaminarayan mantra books, devotionally written by 120,000 of devotees in India. The number of written mantras amounted to 11.25 billion. The huge murtis of Bhagwan Swaminarayan and Gunatitanand Swami were installed on the vedika.
At 6.00 p.m. 28,000 devotees attended the assembly.
Swamishri performed the murti-pratishtha rituals of murtis for the hari mandirs in the villages of Sarol and Tichkiya.

To please Bhagwan Swaminarayan and Guru Pramukh Swami Maharaj children, youths and senior devotees perform austerities, pilgrimages or other devotional means. The spiritual endeavors performed by the devotees during Swamishri's visit to the local centers are congratulatory and worthy of recognition. It also reflects Swamishri's divinity for inspiring such spiritual efforts in children, teenagers and devotees.
26 December 2005, Surat

A devotee of Tadad village performed an 85-hour waterless fast for Swamishri’s good health. His wife and two children performed a fast for one day. Fifteen children pilgrimaged by foot from Segvachha village.
27 December 2005, Surat
Fifty-seven devotees pilgrimaged 25 km by foot from Bhandut village. Sixteen devotees pilgrimaged 23 km by foot from Selut village. Twenty-one devotees pilgrimaged 30 km by foot from Admor village.
28 December 2005, Gandhinagar

Forty-one devotees pilgrimaged 18 km by foot from Sarol village, 27 devotees walked 18 km from Veluk village, 30 devotees walked 21 km from Mota Kosmba and 17 devotees pilgrimaged 16 km from Narthana.
29 December 2005, Surat
Twenty-two and twenty-one devotees pilgrimaged by foot from the villages of Aerthan and Takrana respectively.
30 December 2005, Surat
Seventy-five male devotees, fifty-four female devotees and sixteen children pilgrimaged 15 km from the villages of Kumbhkarni and Hariyana and 17 km from Dihen village.
31 December 2005, Surat
Two hundred and seventeen devotes pilgrimaged by foot from the villages of Kudiyana, Kapasi and others.

Prayasvinbhai, owner of the Madhuban Resort, was sitting before Pramukh Swami Maharaj. Speaking about his business, he said to Swamishri, "My wish is that just as we progress, our employees also progress. And you will be surprised to know that I myself am the leader of the employees' union. They tell me of their own accord that I give them even more than they expect. And I also believe that these are my own people, so where is there any discrimination? And they look after me just as much."

Swamishri said, "They are the ones who do the work, so we should understand that it is a partnership, shouldn't we! And if you take this much care, they too will feel the company is their own. Sometimes you will need to say something, but not to put them down, rather to help them progress with love. This is a very good way."
Swamishri seemed to show an eternal principle of human relationships.

After performing the abhishek of Shri Sahajanand Varni in the abhishek mandap, Mahant Swami Maharaj moved on along the circumambulation path, having darshan of the guru parampara. Seeing Haritilakdas Swami standing there, he said, "You gave a very nice discourse on unity."
Haritilakdas Swami said, "I gave it based on the letter
you wrote."
Swamishri said, "I listened to it twice."
A wonderful joy brimmed in Haritilakdas Swami's eyes.

The reason was that after Pramukh Swami Maharaj passed away to Akshardham, thoughts had started in his mind: "Will Mahant Swami Maharaj know me or not? Will he know my name?" But today, when Swamishri called him of his own accord, the conviction settled in his mind: "This is the same Bapa, and he knows me."
The face is different, but the joy is the same.
The name is different, but the work is the same.
The appearance is different, but the true form is the same.
Pramukh Swami Maharaj is manifest through Swamishri.
When Mahant Swami Maharaj sat for his evening meal, Viveksagardas Swami began reading his article, "Negative feelings, seeing faults and wronging others", with an explanation suited to the occasion.
After finishing his meal, getting up from the sofa, Swamishri said, "If no one saw faults in anyone at all, what fun it would be!"
Then he himself said, "Akshardham."
Swamishri showed a wonderful way to create Akshardham even here on earth.
